purpose: Resolve the initial mask/headgear routing queue with release-specific component evidence. These records extend the 2026-09-24 seed without deleting the original audit trail.

evidence_policy.secondary_catalog_allowed: BrickLink inventory records are accepted as structured secondary component evidence and retain their source limitation.

evidence: no headgear in the minifigure inventory
resolved_records.training_note: A tight fabric full-face mask can be represented entirely as head decoration when silhouette does not require extra geometry.
The pointed cowl silhouette is carried by separate geometry while facial state remains on the underlying head.
Layered wrapping identity is split between printed facial coverage and a separate hood silhouette.
A fitted full-face textile mask can remain entirely in the cylindrical head print when no silhouette change is needed.
Transparent enclosure geometry is a distinct identity channel and should not be flattened into face art.

evidence: no separate standard cylindrical head under the Wookiee form
resolved_records.training_note: Nonhuman cranial/facial volume is carried by a replacement modified head rather than headgear over a human head.
Creature identity can use a dedicated modified head with modular secondary silhouette pieces.

evidence: modified elongated alien head 5706pb01 with four mouth tentacles
resolved_records.training_note: Tentacles and elongated cranial volume require dedicated head geometry rather than flat decoration.

evidence: modified elongated alien head 5469pb01 with mandibles
resolved_records.training_note: Mandibles and alien cranial form are encoded in a modified head; body silhouette extensions remain separate.
Costume identity is removable headgear over a fully modeled human face.
Animal costume heads should be distinguished from true nonhuman modified heads.

evidence: modified Bogeyman head 6846pb01 with pin holes
resolved_records.training_note: Creature head geometry can expose attachment points for modular horns rather than embedding every silhouette feature in one mould.

evidence: separate head-top/ears element 25264 repeated across sampled releases
resolved_records.training_note: Across multiple modern releases, graphics carry mask detail while a minimal ear topper supplies silhouette.

evidence: separate scabbard is bodywear rather than mask geometry
resolved_records.training_note: A close-fitting fabric mask with no required silhouette change is head decoration only.

evidence: no headgear in standard minifigure inventory
resolved_records.training_note: Standard-minifigure Venom uses printed cylindrical-head identity; larger creature/mech/brick-built Venom forms must remain separate figure-form records rather than being mixed into this route.
